title: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights

entities.name: Errant
entities.description: A painter and tagger raised among the Maestros who works with the New Capennan resistance, placing charges in the city's core and fighting converter beasts with Halo paint.

entities.name: Parnesse
entities.description: Errant's wife, an artist who is wounded in the leg and who joins the resistance with her.

entities.name: Anhelo
entities.description: Errant's father, a former head of the Maestros who has been Phyrexianized and tries to convert her.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: A giant Phyrexian angel leading the conversion of New Capenna, lured to Park Heights by the resistance's plan.

entities.name: Della
entities.description: An angel who aids the resistance, healing Errant and Parnesse with her Halo, signaling Atraxa's position and leading angels into the Multiverse.

entities.name: Perrie
entities.description: A Broker who negotiated with the angels for Halo and holds some in reserve.

entities.name: Kamiz
entities.description: An Obscura member of Errant's team who reads tagger's scrawl.

entities.name: Henzie
entities.description: A Riveteer demolitions expert who built the explosives and plan Operation Falling Star.

entities.name: Ziatora
entities.description: A New Capennan family leader whom Henzie reports to.

entities.name: Falco
entities.description: A Broker causing trouble for Atraxa and drawing her to the Nido sanctuary.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who control much of New Capenna, including converter beasts.

entities.name: Converter beast
entities.description: Phyrexian beasts with injector tails and cages on their backs that convert captives.

entities.name: The Maestros
entities.description: A New Capennan family of artists, most of whom have been Phyrexianized.

entities.name: The Riveteers
entities.description: The New Capennan engineer family whose members rebel and plant the explosives.

entities.name: The Brokers
entities.description: A New Capennan family that hoarded Halo and led by Falco joins the plan.

entities.name: The Obscura
entities.description: A New Capennan family that fights the invaders.

entities.name: Angels of New Capenna
entities.description: Beings of Halo whose return and unleashing into the Multiverse helps turn the tide.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: The art-deco city plane overrun by the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: The once-gilded upper city of New Capenna that the resistance brings down on Atraxa.

entities.name: The Mezzio
entities.description: The colorful district of New Capenna now ashen gray.

entities.name: Invasion Tree
entities.description: The branching Phyrexian tree overgrowing New Capenna's sky.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: A powerful magic made of angels that heals and can prevent Phyrexian conversion.

entities.name: Operation Falling Star
entities.description: The resistance's plan to destroy Park Heights' core on Atraxa's head.

entities.name: Nido sanctuary
entities.description: A sanctuary where Atraxa might go to end Falco's trouble.

entities.name: Treza
entities.description: A hideout location in which the resistance team has claimed rooms.

events.summary: In a dream-memory of her wedding, Errant and Parnesse dance among the Maestros until Phyrexian oil transforms the guests, including her father Anhelo, and Atraxa tears off the roof.
events.quote: the roof of the Maestro's museum was ripped clean off

events.summary: Errant wakes in an abandoned station when a converter beast crashes through the wall, hunting her and Parnesse.
events.quote: The crash of a Phyrexian converter beast plunging through the wall had shattered their brief reprieve.

events.summary: Errant and Parnesse flee over rails and ledges with stolen Riveteer explosives, using tagger's scrawl to find safe paths.
events.quote: The two heavy satchels that were laden with the explosives they had stolen from an old Riveteer's stash in the Mezzio clanked against her hips

events.summary: Cornered by two converter beasts, Errant and Parnesse choose to blow themselves up rather than be converted.
events.quote: "I love you until every canvas is filled."

events.summary: Errant wakes in the resistance hideout and learns Della healed them with Halo.
events.quote: Luckily, I was present to mend your wounds instantly

events.summary: Della says Halo cannot cure Phyrexianization but can prevent conversion.
events.quote: Halo can act as preventative against the conversion, but not a cure.

events.summary: The team debates, and Henzie reveals the Riveteers found the city's core and plans to bring down Park Heights.
events.quote: There's a core to the city—think like a main support beam

events.summary: Errant agrees to place the charges after Parnesse insists on the choice, and the team explains Operation Falling Star.
The team plans to lure Atraxa to the Nido sanctuary with Falco's trouble and angels, with Della to signal.
events.quote: "Then the lead cockroach herself might go to the Nido sanctuary to put an end to it,"

events.summary: The families rally; Falco's Brokers take position, Della rallies angels, and Parnesse shepherds citizens while Errant heads for the core.
events.quote: But, at last, they had worked out the final details.

events.summary: Converter beasts chase the escaping citizens, and Errant uses Halo paint jars and her sprayer to defeat them.
events.quote: Paint sprayed out, swirling with the iridescent rainbows of the Halo with which it was infused.

events.summary: Errant places the charges in the city's core and finds her Phyrexianized father Anhelo blocking her way.
Anhelo tries to persuade Errant to join New Phyrexia, and she argues beauty is mess and experimentation.
events.quote: "Beauty isn't found by coloring in the lines.

events.summary: Della's Halo signal shows Atraxa is in position; Errant says goodbye to her father and detonates the core, collapsing Park Heights.
events.quote: The core above her burst with orange flame and smoke.

events.summary: Della catches Errant as she falls from a missed jump and glides her to safety.
events.quote: Then, two sturdy arms wrapped themselves around her.

events.summary: The Invasion Tree's branches shrivel as angels with Halo are unleashed into the Multiverse through the portals.
events.quote: "The angels are being unleashed into the Multiverse, bringing the power of Halo with them."

events.summary: Errant reunites with Parnesse and her allies at the safe zone as the angels depart.
events.quote: "Parnesse!" Errant opened her arms just in time for Parnesse to throw herself into them.

relations.quote: And her wife's smile as they glided across the dance floor?
Even her father, Anhelo, had been transformed.

relations.note: Anhelo has been converted and tries to bring Errant over
relations.quote: Come, I can show you the beauty of New Phyrexia.

relations.note: Atraxa leads the conversion of New Capenna
relations.quote: The head Phyrexian had been content to ignore them so far.
Luckily, I was present to mend your wounds instantly

relations.note: Perrie negotiates for the Brokers' Halo

relations.quote: "The Riveteers still got fight left in 'em.

relations.note: Kamiz says the Obscura are fighting
relations.quote: "The Obscura are fighting as well," Kamiz added.

relations.note: Errant says she grew up with them but was never one
relations.quote: "I was never a Maestro. Just grew up with them."

relations.note: Errant destroys Park Heights on her head
relations.quote: Atraxa had wanted New Capenna and would have it shoved down her throat in pieces.
